comment: Shared refusal vectors. Each case is a VALID committed vector with exactly one field changed, so the refusal below is attributable to that field and not to a second defect the fixture happened to carry (QUAL-02). src/vectors.test.ts runs the validators; python/test_oracle_vectors.py checks this file's shape and independently evaluates the enum-drift cases against its own pinned vocabularies.

cases.label: request at an unsupported schema version

admissionAssumptions.assumed: No cutoff was stated, so the question is read as being about the current state.

payload.decisionToInform: Choose the smallest change needed for truthful institutional source reading.
payload.question: At the captured source revision, can the reader distinguish a complete requested section from a search snippet, a truncated page, a failed fetch and an unsupported PDF?
payload.consequenceOfNoAnswer: The reader ships with four read outcomes collapsed into one, and every claim built on it inherits an unstated limitation.

acceptanceCriteria: Each of the four read outcomes is distinguishable from the delivered record alone.
